title: Sign in or create an account
instructions: Use your @haw-hamburg.de email address. We will send a single-use sign-in link. No password is required.
syncDisclosure: Sign in to sync calendars, calendar links and preferences across devices. Guest data stays in this browser or device unless you choose to import it.
sent: Check your inbox. The link expires in 10 minutes. Open it on the device you want to sign in to.
invalidEmail: Use a valid address ending exactly in @haw-hamburg.de.
rateLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
mailUnavailable: Email delivery is not configured or could not be confirmed. Please try again later.
unavailable: The account service is unavailable. Please try again later.
confirmInstructions: Continue to verify your email and sign in on this device. This link can be used once.
invalidLink: This link is invalid, expired or already used. Request a new sign-in link.
switchBlocked: Another account has unsynced changes on this device. Sign back into that account to sync them, or explicitly discard its local changes before continuing.
discardPrevious: Discard previous account’s local changes and continue
cacheLocked: This account’s encrypted local cache could not be opened. Your data has not been reset. Retry after device secure storage becomes available.
guestLocal: Your calendars and preferences stay on this device. Sign in to enable account sync.
conflicts: Conflicting changes: {{count}}. Local edits are kept; newer cloud data has not been overwritten.
syncFailed: Sync failed or needs attention. Local changes are retained. Check your connection and retry.
actionFailed: The action could not finish. Data is retained. Check your connection and try again; account deletion may require signing in again.
pendingWarning: Unsynced changes remain. Sync them before signing out, explicitly discard them, or cancel.
revokeWarning: This signs out all devices. You will need a new email link to sign in again.
discardAndSignOut: Discard pending changes and sign out
deleteWarning: Permanently delete your account, all synced records and this device’s account cache, including unsynced edits. The separate guest data stays on this device.
importDisclosure: Copy this device’s guest calendars to this account. The guest originals stay on the device. Reimporting unchanged calendars will not duplicate them; changed calendars can conflict with cloud edits.
independent: An independent student-maintained project. This is not your myHAW login.
legalPending: The student association has not configured its privacy and legal contact pages yet.
cloudCopyWarning: Use the saved account versions for conflicting calendars? Your unsynced edits to these calendars will be discarded. Other pending changes are kept.
syncPrivacyDetails: Signing in enables account sync. Synced calendars, private calendar links and preferences are stored on club-controlled infrastructure, encrypted at rest. Club infrastructure can decrypt them. Guest data stays on your device unless you choose to import it.
profileLoadFailed: Your saved account data could not be opened on this device. Your data has not been reset.
